message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors: missing MockitoExtension import. Since we are not using Mockito in this test, we can remove the import and @ExtendWith annotation. So delete import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; and the @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation.

Also need to ensure any other missing imports? The code uses JsonSchemaFactory, SpecVersion.VersionFlag. Those classes are part of library. Should be okay.

Also need to ensure we have static import for arguments already present.

Thus corrected code: remove those lines.

Potentially need to add import for JsonSchemaFactory and SpecVersion? Not present currently. The code references JsonSchemaFactory but not imported. Indeed at top we have only imports: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode; com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; org.junit.jupiter.api.*; java.lang.reflect.Method; static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.*; org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest; org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments; org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource; java.math.BigInteger; java.util.stream.Stream; static org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments.arguments; org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith; org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

But missing import for JsonSchemaFactory and SpecVersion.VersionFlag. In the code they refer to JsonSchemaFactory factory = JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012); So need import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory; import com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion; Probably also import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema; Already referencing class in same package, so not needed.

Thus add imports.

Also need to ensure we have import for JsonSchema class? It's same package, no import needed.

Thus final code includes imports for JsonSchemaFactory and SpecVersion.

Remove MockitoExtension import and annotation.

Let's produce corrected code.
